title: CSF cytology: core principles, diagnostic pitfalls and emerging digital tools including artificial intelligence and telecytology
title_zh: 脑脊液细胞学：核心原理、诊断陷阱与新兴数字工具（包括人工智能和远程细胞学）
abstract: Abstract Cerebrospinal fluid cytology remains a cornerstone of diagnostic evaluation in infectious, autoimmune, haemorrhagic, and neoplastic disorders of the central nervous system despite advances in neuroimaging, molecular diagnostics, and digital technologies. This narrative review summarises established principles of cerebrospinal fluid cytology, highlights methodological limitations and diagnostic pitfalls, and integrates emerging developments, including automated cell counting, artificial intelligence, and telecytology. Pre-analytical factors are critical determinants of diagnostic accuracy. Delayed sample processing promotes pH-dependent autolysis and substantial cell loss, whereas rapid cytocentrifugation preserves cellular morphology and facilitates reliable assessment. Automated cell counters are increasingly implemented in routine laboratories and offer advantages in settings with limited technical staffing. However, current systems show limited precision in samples with low and slightly elevated cell counts and limited morphological evaluation. Manual chamber counting, particularly in the normal and low-cell-count range, remains the gold standard for quantitative CSF cell assessment, whereas expert microscopic examination remains the reference standard for qualitative cytomorphological assessment. Although the sensitivity of neuroimaging continues to improve, cerebrospinal fluid cytology retains a unique diagnostic role in the detection of infectious and neoplastic conditions and in the evaluation of subarachnoid haemorrhage. Cytological detection of erythrophages, siderophages, and haematoidin crystals can reveal haemorrhage and provide clues to its temporal stage. Overall, cerebrospinal fluid cytology remains a valuable diagnostic tool when integrated with clinical, laboratory, microbiological, immunological, and imaging findings. Careful recognition of common pitfalls is essential. We recommend rapid cerebrospinal fluid processing, routine preparation of cytospin-based stained slides with expert microscopic review, and the implementation of automated or digital methods only within clearly validated workflows.
abstract_zh: 摘要 脑脊液细胞学在中枢神经系统感染、自身免疫、出血及肿瘤性疾病的诊断评估中仍是基石，尽管神经影像、分子诊断和数字技术取得了进展。本综述概括了脑脊液细胞学既定原理，重点阐述方法学局限性和诊断陷阱，并整合新兴发展，包括自动细胞计数、人工智能和远程细胞学。预分析因素是诊断准确性的关键决定因素。样本处理延迟会导致pH依赖性细胞溶解和显著细胞丢失，而快速细胞细离心可保留细胞形态并促进可靠评估。自动细胞计数在常规实验室中日益普及，在技术人员有限的环境中具有优势。然而，现有系统在细胞计数低和略升高样本中的精确性有限，且在形态学评估方面受限。在正常和细胞计数低的范围内，手动计数仍是脑脊液细胞计量评估的金标准，而专家显微镜检查仍是定性细胞形态学评估的参考标准。尽管神经影像的敏感性不断提高，脑脊液细胞学在检测感染和肿瘤疾病、以及亚硬膜下出血评估方面仍保留独特的诊断作用。细胞学检出红细胞吞噬细胞、铁粒吞噬细胞和血红素晶体可揭示出血并提供其时间阶段的线索。总体而言，脑脊液细胞学在与临床、实验室、微生物学、免疫学和影像学发现相结合时，仍是一项宝贵的诊断工具。对常见陷阱的谨慎识别至关重要。我们建议快速处理脑脊液，常规制备细胞细染片并进行专家显微镜审查，并仅在明确验证的工作流中实施自动化或数字化方法。
